entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: AS security activated

entities.name: Establishment of RBs

entities.description: Operation to establish Backhaul RLC Channels for IAB.

entities.name: Establishment of Uu Relay RLC channels
entities.description: Operation to establish Uu Relay RLC channels for L2 U2N Relay UE.

entities.name: reconfigurationWithSync in secondaryCellGroup
entities.description: IE for reconfiguration with synchronization in Secondary Cell Group.

entities.name: reconfigurationWithSync in masterCellGroup
entities.description: IE for reconfiguration with synchronization in Master Cell Group.

entities.name: conditionalReconfiguration for CPC
entities.description: IE for conditional reconfiguration for Conditional PSCell Change.

entities.name: conditionalReconfiguration for CHO or CPA
entities.description: IE for conditional reconfiguration for Conditional Handover or Conditional PSCell Addition.

entities.name: At least one RLC bearer setup in SCG
entities.description: Condition requiring at least one RLC bearer to be established in Secondary Cell Group.

entities.name: SRB2 with at least one DRB setup and not suspended
entities.description: Condition requiring SRB2 and at least one DRB (or multicast MRB, or for IAB SRB2) to be established and not suspended.

relations.description: RRC reconfiguration procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Establishment of RBs is guarded by AS security activation condition.
Establishment of BH RLC Channels is guarded by AS security activation condition.
Establishment of Uu Relay RLC channels is guarded by AS security activation condition.
Addition of SCG and SCells is guarded by AS security activation condition.
reconfigurationWithSync in SCG is guarded by condition of at least one RLC bearer setup in SCG.
reconfigurationWithSync in MCG is guarded by AS security activation condition.
reconfigurationWithSync in MCG is guarded by SRB2 and DRB setup condition.
conditionalReconfiguration for CPC is guarded by condition of at least one RLC bearer setup in SCG.
conditionalReconfiguration for CHO/CPA is guarded by AS security activation condition.
conditionalReconfiguration for CHO/CPA is guarded by SRB2 and DRB setup condition.
